title: A unified parametric approach to the Erdős--Straus conjecture with explicit solutions for a set of integers of natural density one
summary: We develop a parametric approach to study the Diophantine equation $\frac{k}{n} = \frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y} + \frac{1}{z}$, underlying the Erdős--Straus ($k=4$), Sierpiński ($k=5$), and related generalizations. We introduce and analyze the properties of the fundamental function $F_{x,t}^{(k)}(n) = t^2(kx-n)^2 - 2nxt$, whose being a perfect square is equivalent to yielding a solution of these conjectures.
